def fib(n):
  """This function returns the nth Fibonacci number."""
  i = 0
  j = 1
  n = n - 1

  while n >= 0:
    i, j = j, i + j
    n = n - 1
  
  return i

def nextDay(year, month, day):
    """
    Returns the year, month, day of the next day.
    Simple version: assume every month has 30 days.
    """
    years = year 
    months = month
    days = day + 1
    if days > 30:
        days = 1
        months = month + 1
        if months > 12:
            months = 1
            years = year + 1
    return (years, months, days)

def get_new_filename(artist: str, title: str) -> str:
    """
    Get new filename for the track. Remove all symbols, replace spaces with underscores

    :param artist:
    :param title:
    :return:
    """

    tmp_data = []
    for data in [artist, title]:
        tmp_data.append(''.join([i.lower() if i != ' ' else '_' for i in data if i.isalnum() or i == ' ']))

    return '{0}-{1}.mp3'.format(*tmp_data)

def get_mr_title(commit_prefix, source_branch):
    """Gets the title of the MR. If a prefix exists we add it to the URL. By default we add a prefix of WIP, so the
    MR doesn't get merged by accident.

    Args:
        commit_prefix (str): Prefix for the MR title i.e. WIP.
        source_branch (str): The source branch to merge into..

    Returns:
        str: Title of the MR we will create .

    """
    commit_title = source_branch
    if commit_prefix:
        commit_title = f"{commit_prefix}: {commit_title}"
    return commit_title
